# M9-S2: perf::large_backing_array_pin reads escape analysis and
# perf::time_after_in_loop reads syntax; both are warn rules that apply to
# loGo/s packages on every build and to Go packages under logos lint only.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# A loGo/s build prints both warnings and still builds. The escape finding
# comes from the compile, after escape analysis.
cd lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgo$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:7:\d+: warning: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\] subslice of a 65537-byte backing array escapes'
stderr 'main\.lgo:12:5: warning: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\] time\.After in a loop body'
exists $WORK/bin/lgo$GOEXE
cd ..

# perf = "deny" turns each into an error that stops the build. A deny finding
# of the syntax phase ends the compile before escape analysis, so each rule
# has its own module here.
cd lgodeny
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgodeny$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:5:\d+: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/lgodeny$GOEXE
cd ..

cd lgodenytime
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgodenytime$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:7:5: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/lgodenytime$GOEXE
cd ..

# perf = "allow" is silent and does not run escape tracking.
cd lgoallow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoallow$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/lgoallow$GOEXE
cd ..

# //logos:allow silences the escape finding and the syntax finding at deny.
cd lgoallowed
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoallowed$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/lgoallowed$GOEXE
cd ..

# A Go package: logos lint prints both warnings, writes no binary, and exits
# 0; logos build and go build print nothing.
cd gopkg
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:7:\d+: warning: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\] subslice of a 65537-byte backing array escapes'
stderr 'main\.go:12:5: warning: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! exists gopkg
! exists gopkg$GOEXE
logos build ./...
! stderr .
go build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# logos lint with perf = "deny" fails on a Go package, one module per rule
# for the same reason as above.
cd godeny
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:5:\d+: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

cd godenytime
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:7:5: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# The JSON record of the escape finding names the rule and the file.
cd gopkg
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"severity":"warn","rule_id":"perf::large_backing_array_pin","file":"[^"]*main\.go","span":\{"start_line":7,'
cd ..

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/lgo

go 1.27

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	return buf[:10]
}

func wait(d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		<-time.After(d)
	}
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
	wait(time.Millisecond)
}

-- lgodeny/go.mod --
module example.com/lgodeny

go 1.27

-- lgodeny/logos.toml --
[lints]
perf = "deny"

-- lgodeny/main.lgo --
package main

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	return buf[:10]
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
}

-- lgodenytime/go.mod --
module example.com/lgodenytime

go 1.27

-- lgodenytime/logos.toml --
[lints]
perf = "deny"

-- lgodenytime/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func wait(d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		<-time.After(d)
	}
}

func main() {
	wait(time.Millisecond)
}

-- lgoallow/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoallow

go 1.27

-- lgoallow/logos.toml --
[lints]
perf = "allow"

-- lgoallow/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	return buf[:10]
}

func wait(d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		<-time.After(d)
	}
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
	wait(time.Millisecond)
}

-- lgoallowed/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoallowed

go 1.27

-- lgoallowed/logos.toml --
[lints]
perf = "deny"

-- lgoallowed/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	//logos:allow(perf::large_backing_array_pin)
	return buf[:10]
}

func wait(d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		//logos:allow(perf::time_after_in_loop)
		<-time.After(d)
	}
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
	wait(time.Millisecond)
}
